test_title: PYST 93: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
If A + B means A is the wife of B. A × B means A is the father of B, A ÷ B means A is the mother of B. A $ B means A is the brother of B and A - B means A is the sister of B.

If Z - T ÷ S × Y + H $ B. then how is Z related to S?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 $
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Sister
 Father
 Mother
 Brother 
 
 

 

Given: Z - T ÷ S × Y + H $ B

It means: Z is the sister of T, T is the mother of S, S is the father of Y, Y is the wife of H and H is the brother of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b76859b6bc9bfd260ee5be1957171dd78a0f9a7b27145a2f850918b580c196c6.png] 

So, Z is the '**Mother's sister**' of S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Mother's sister'.
